keyFindings.description:
In the document-wide step (acrossBlocks), surroundedBy takes any ' ' for a block edge. documentText reads a hard break (Milkdown hardbreak leafText ' ') and a code block's own line breaks as ' ' too. So a whole-block or short-edge selection whose block is deleted still moves silently onto a line of another paragraph or code block. Reproduced by both reviewers: 'Ship it now.' / 'Notes:
Ship it now.
Later text here.', first block deleted -> mark on the second paragraph. This also makes false the PR body claim that the round-4 limit is the only case where a record reaches a passage the reader did not select. Fix: test edges against documentText's blocks offsets, not a character.

A skipped stale count relies on the row's write to report again, but the rejection branch (:383-385) only logs. So a failed IndexedDB write leaves the toolbar on the old count and a whenSent wait runs to its bound. Report on both outcomes.

setAnchorRefusal(undefined) before the 5 s whenSent wait puts the server's 'anchor mark is not in the document' back on screen between 'Re-attaching…' and the retry. Keep REANCHOR_IN_PROGRESS under the new mark id until the retry's outcome.
